name: 区営住宅の家族向け1戸を単身者向け2戸に
summary: 東大泉一丁目アパートと豊玉北一丁目アパートで、家族向け住宅1戸を単身者向け住宅2戸に改修します。これに伴って戸数を改め、令和8年4月1日に施行します。
changes: 家族向け住宅1戸を単身者向け住宅2戸に改修する

why: 家族向け住宅1戸を単身者向け住宅2戸に改修するためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Converts one family unit into two units for single occupants
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Nerima City Municipal Housing Ordinance
en.summary: At Higashi-Oizumi 1-chome Apartments and Toyotamakita 1-chome Apartments, one family unit will be renovated into two units for single occupants. The number of units will be revised accordingly, and the ordinance will take effect on April 1, 2026.
changes: Renovates one family unit into two units for single occupants
who: Single people who want to move into city-operated housing
en.why: The ward says this is to renovate one family unit into two units for single occupants.
